metadata.description: Practical Claude Code skills for real workflows

plugins.name: done
plugins.description: End-of-session wrap-up: detects what changed, updates CLAUDE.md with gotchas only, runs tests, commits only this session's files (creating a repo with a secret check for new projects), and prints a short status report.

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: Save an unfinished session to a handoffs/ Markdown file (handoff) and pick it back up in a fresh session, with drift checks against the current code (resume-handoff).

plugins.name: codec-loop
plugins.description: Adversarial review and build loops between Claude and OpenAI Codex: codec-review has Codex critique a plan or codebase read-only while Claude judges and rewrites; codec-build hands a frozen spec to a second model to implement, then runs a bounded review-and-fix loop over the diff. Needs the Codex CLI and codex login; without them, an opt-in same-family mode uses a different Claude model as the critic (weaker, still independent). Windows and macOS (macOS untested).
